title: Ivo and the Vector
author: B. M. Brightwater
blurb: Orsen Vasquez, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must deliver a message that will end the war — or start it before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
